notes.title: Change the operation mode of the glider to be consistent with reality
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45346454/89b7db945f2c5998e6e3a7edf1f525bba6fa8244.png[/img]
1. The operation mode of the glider has been changed to be consistent with reality: the dual handles are extended forward for climbing, the dual handles are pulled closer for diving, the dual handles swing left to right, and the dual handles swing right to left.
2. Changed the menu control mode of the game hall to maximize device compatibility
3. Added a demonstration of glider operation.
